subject: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@bridgekit.io>; procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline

Hi Maya —

Thanks for confirming BridgeKit as our vendor for the observability connector. Procurement asked me to kick off the vendor-setup and PO intake so we can get a purchase order issued on time. Can you confirm the following so we can move forward this week?

1) Legal / finance docs: Do you have a completed vendor intake form and W-9 ready? If so please attach (PDF preferred).
2) Remit & billing: Who should invoices be addressed to and where should they be sent (email + postal remittance address if applicable)?
3) Line-item breakdown: We need unitized line-items (SKU or short code, quantity, unit price, description, period). I attached a sample_lineitem_csv.csv with the schema we prefer — are you able to provide a matching CSV?
4) PO lead time: Procurement estimates ~10 business days after vendor setup is complete to issue the first PO (subject to contract signoff). Do you have any constraints (tax paperwork, bank details, or PO acceptance process) that would extend that timeline?

If you can drop the vendor_form and W-9 and a sample line-item CSV by EOD tomorrow (12/6), Laura will start the intake and I’ll scope the expected PO timeline so we can align dates for kickoff.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Sr. Program Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Maya Singh <maya@bridgekit.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-12-05T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching the completed vendor intake form and our W-9 (attached as bridgekit_vendor_form.pdf and bridgekit_w9.pdf). We also included a sample CSV exported from our billing system — the column names differ slightly from your sample but the mapping is straightforward.

Quick notes:
- Billing: Invoices to be issued to accounts-payable@bridgekit.io; postal remittance to BridgeKit, Inc., 424 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Payment terms: Net 45 by default for new customers; we can agree to Net 30 if that helps PO approval.
- Banking: We use Stripe Connect for payouts — if your AP team requires a bank statement for verification we can provide it, but we prefer sharing payment links on invoices.
- PO acknowledgement: We receive PO numbers via email and upload to our vendor portal; we typically acknowledge within 1 business day.

We attached the CSV we can export today and included a short mapping file (note in email): sample_lineitem_csv.csv. If you prefer a different column order we can re-export.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if any of this needs clarification.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships
BridgeKit, Inc.
maya@bridgekit.io

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@bridgekit.io>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline

Thanks — looks good. Two quick procurement notes:

1) Please ask vendor to include a short SKU (max 10 chars) in the CSV; this prevents parsing issues in our AP upload. We prefer a field named "vendor_sku".
2) For initial PO, Finance needs the signed SOW or a DocuSign cover page confirming scope & price. If BridgeKit can push a DocuSign link (even a cover sheet) that references our deal ID (RDW-bridgekit-2026-093) we can accelerate routing.

Laura — on timeline, can you confirm target PO issuance date assuming vendor intake completes tomorrow? I think 12/17 is realistic (10 business days + review).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Finance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@bridgekit.io>
Date: 2026-12-06T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline

Confirmed — I started the vendor intake with the attachments Maya provided. Next steps and estimated dates:

- 12/06: Vendor intake form + W-9 received (complete). I uploaded bridgekit_vendor_form.pdf to the intake queue.
- 12/07: Finance to validate tax and remit details; request any missing bank verification.
- 12/09: Legal to review SOW/DocuSign cover sheet (if BridgeKit sends).
- 12/17: Target PO issuance (assuming DocuSign and SOW accepted).

A couple of clarifications for BridgeKit: please include in the CSV these exact headers: vendor_sku, description, qty, unit_price, currency, start_date, end_date, tax_code. If you prefer, I can reformat the CSV after you send it and return a cleaned copy for your approval — that will save time in AP.

Link to standard vendor intake checklist: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/vendor-intake-templates (internal).

I will follow up if anything else is missing.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya@bridgekit.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: PO requirements + line-item mapping & issuance timeline

Hi all —

Thanks — we can deliver the CSV with the exact headers Laura requested by tomorrow morning (12/08). We also uploaded a one-page SOW and initiated a DocuSign cover sheet that references deal RDW-bridgekit-2026-093 (link: https://www.docusign.com/link/BridgeKit-PO-Setup).

Regarding payment terms: we can accept Net 30 for the first PO as a courtesy to Redwood.

I'll send the corrected CSV and a confirmation note once the DocuSign is completed.

Best,
Maya
